_about: Hand-curated place data for the real coast (stage 1b). Read by src/coast-world.js, merged into the name list by src/names.js buildNameList. Not generated: assets/coast/names.json is, and is rebuilt by tools/fetch-names.mjs, so these live here. Source for descriptions: Felix's Map Lab (GAME-DESIGN.md 'Chart naming'); they are lore, not etymology claims.

descriptionNotes.Stora Kornö: The Map Lab says 'Kornö = the barley isle'. OSM has Stora Kornö (island, 58.2978 N) and Kornö kalv (skerry); the description sits on the island. It lies in the 80 m edge-fade strip at the north border of today's window, so it is not on the chart yet; it appears when the window grows north. TODO(felix): confirm Stora Kornö is the Kornö meant.
descriptionNotes.Stångehuvud: No entry in names.json or settlements, so no place yet. TODO(felix): confirm; geocode by exact OSM name when Overpass answers (it was at capacity, 2026-11-05).
descriptionNotes.Islandsberg: As Stångehuvud. TODO(felix): confirm, geocode by exact OSM name.
